name: Dire Rat
description: A mouse-like monster that lives in sewers. They can be found all over, and are resented as they chew on everything and are carriers of disease. Though not particularly strong on its own, since they usually act in groups, they can be quite a challenge for anyone who comes across them. Towns and villages have taken countermeasures to combat them, but thanks to their incredible reproductive abilities, their numbers are hard to keep in check.

locations: Time for Revenge: Time for Revenge

name: Stunner
description: A subspecies of dire rat. They used to inhabit towns, but have had to adapt to the outside world since humans destroyed their natural habitat. Because of this, it is much more resilient than normal dire rats, and has even developed resistance to poison and other toxins. It is good at stunning enemies by unleashing violent physical attacks. It is possible to avoid the stunner's attack by listening for it scurrying about in the darkness.

name: Nutkin
description: A squirrel-like monster found in the grassy plains. It often carries around acorns which are highly nutritious and often used in medicine. Despite being a gentle little creature who would never attack humans, should someone try to steal its beloved acorns it would counterattack without hesitation. Currently, seemingly due in part to the crystal being destroyed, many have become more aggressive, attacking anyone who gets near them, regardless of whether or not they pose a threat to their acorns.

name: Mu
description: A squirrel-like monster that looks similar to the nutkin. Mus are also known to carry around acorns, though they tend to live in nests in the ground. It eats acorns every day, and since it also relies on them to survive the hard winter, it can often be seen carrying them to store in its nest. Mu pelts are relatively easy to obtain, and thanks to their soft texture they are often used in making items like clothes and so forth.

name: Peeper
description: A squirrel-like monster that makes its nest in the ground, similar to mus. They are incredibly wary creatures. It is said its name came from how it would burrow underground like a badger, and before coming back up it would stick only its head out to check if there were any enemies around. However, once engaged in a fight, it seems it goes into a frenzy, and, completely forgetting to retreat, instead recklessly attacks its opponent. Its pink pelt is popular as a fashion accessory for women.

name: Wild Nakk
description: A type of wolf. They inhabit areas around towns and villages, and are despised as they often prey on livestock. It is very clever, and quickly breaks down any and all manner of traps set out to get rid of it. This ability is said to be connected to the mysterious force preying upon the crystal in recent years. Though obedient when properly trained, since they aren't usually friendly toward humans, the actual method used to train them is clouded in mystery.

name: Worgen
description: The leader of the wolves. Wolves instinctually move in packs, at the center of which worgens are often found. They usually communicate by howling, and are good at coordinating their efforts when stalking prey. Originally, this species was not known to attack humans unprovoked, but lately there have been a fair amount of reports claiming attacks by packs of wolves.

name: Wolf
description: A dog-like creature found all over the world. Though it possesses sharp claws and fangs, it is timid by nature. Up until recently, even when it was forced to go after livestock to keep itself fed, it would never approach human settlements. However, as recent reports indicate that these animals have begun openly attacking humans, it had been confirmed that they have grown more ferocious than before. It is unknown whether or not this has anything to do with the broken crystal, but either way it is best to err on the side of caution.

name: Belmodar
description: The belmodar has an armor-like carapace and wicked horns sprouting from its head, shoulders, and nose. It is just as powerful and ferocious as it looks. When struck physically, it lashes back by unleashing the powerful electric current it generates within its body. Given the strength of its skin, some craftsmen have hoped to make powerful items from belmodar hide but the project does not seem very realistic considering how many monsters would have to be defeated to obtain a goodly amount.

name: Steel Bat
description: A bat that has been driven mad by the taste of human blood. This nocturnal creature loves the dark, and often inhabits caves. Since it finds its way around by emitting sound waves and listening to how they echo, it doesn't tend to use its eyes very often, which has led its eyesight to become poor. It is quick to approach any humans it senses as it is always thirsty for blood, but since it can only draw blood and can't really attack, as long as one keeps their cool it shouldn't pose any real threat.

description: An old warrior that protects one of the twelve shining arms. He once showed prominence as a warrior, leading many soldiers into battle, but his achievements led to jealousy from those with power, who then orders him an impossible mission of invading enemy lines. In exchange of leaving his soldiers out of the mission, he suggests a plan where he hides in a stone casket to be taken to the enemy lines. He succeeds getting through the enemy lines, and leaps out of the casket, fighting until his very end. description: A man who stands before Fina and her party in a world robbed of its future, calling himself a Hollow Keeper. Using the power of the Hollow, he has stolen the light from Poppy's heart. Considering herself worthless now that she has lost the strength to brighten the mood of the team, Poppy falls into a pit of self-loathing.

locations: Daybreak Prairie - Rematch with Keeper Moneta

name: Voa Andigo
description: The Hollow, having taken the form of a dragon. Of the Hollow Dragons confirmed thus far, this one is the largest. Though they were originally forced to fight against each other over differences in what they seek to protect, both Team Fina and Team Chorale have set aside their differences, banding together to fight the enormous Voa Andigo.

locations: Daybreak Prairie - The Day of Oblivion Has Come

name: Keeper Spada
description: A man who stands before Rain and his party, calling himself a Hollow Keeper. In his eyes, humanity is a source of endless war, and there can be no true peace unless all is erased from the world. Only by awakening their blood do Rain and Lasswell stand any chance against Spada.

name: The Will of Oblivion
description: A being intent on returning all to nothingness. Along with the Will of Light, it once protected the balance of the world. However, with the power of the Will of Light fading, the Will of Oblivion now leverages wormholes and the Hollow Keepers in an attempt to erase all from existance. Fina and company, who have amplified the power of light, must now face down this overwhelmingly powerful opponent if they are to save the world.

locations: Heart of the Hollow - The Will of Oblivion
Flood of Light - A Rematch with the Will of Oblivion

name: Enkidu
description: A scheming monster which appeared in 'Xezat's Fleet' in a faraway world. Along with Gilgamesh, the captain of Exdeath's elite guard, it launched a surprise attack on Xezat's flagship. Known as Gilgamesh's right-hand man, its combat skills are enough to fight Xezat as his equal. In its world of origin, it drew upon a wide variety of abilities to back Gilgamesh up, including white wind and aerora.

name: Gobbledygook
description: A scheming monster which appeared in 'Xezat's Fleet' in a faraway world. Along with Gilgamesh, the captain of Exdeath's elite guard, it launched a surprise attack on Xezat's ship. Little more than a glorified goblin, it may not be a threat on its own, but it should not be underestimated when attacking in numbers.

name: Keeper Garote
description: A man who stands before Fina and her party in a world where tomorrow never comes, calling himself a Hollow Keeper. He has the power to reach into people's hearts and bring out their bleakest memories. It is an attack by Keeper Garote that renders Kalmia and Nerine unable even to stand up as the memories of their most hopeless moments weigh them down.

locations: The Seven-Color Road - Until She Breaks

name: Crunchu
description: A mutated ochu, this gigantic plantoid monster can freely manipulate its long tentacles. This creature will eat plants, animals, and even minerals, after which it will start shaking to facilitate digestion. In fact, the sounds it makes while consuming mineral fragments—and the subsequent crunching sounds those fragments emit as they are broken up—is apparently where this monster's onomatopoeic name comes from. It has a particular taste for valuable jewels, which leaves those who encounter it with the option of quickly discarding any jewelry they might have and running away.

locations: The Hill Over the Lighthouse - Omnivorous Plant (Boss Battle)

name: Munchu
description: A smaller, younger version of the crunchu. It may seem cute with its round shape, but it is in fact a gluttonous creature that will chomp anything it comes across to pieces. It roams around as part of a group, notifying the crunchu the moment it sights any dangerous foes. Despite its small size, it can often be seen with no parent to guard it, as its burning curiosity gives it the tendency to wander off on its own. It is also said that it will intentionally leave its group to gorge itself day and night, until it becomes a fully grown crunchu itself.

name: Blood Feeder
description: A spirit that appeared from nowhere. It seems to primarily subsist on blood, gorging itself on that of its prey until not a single drop remains. Any suspiciously dry-looking corpse could be a sign that this spirit is not far away, in which case taking an alternative route would be the wisest choice.

name: The Will of Oblivion - Moneta
description: Keeper Moneta, who appears before Roca and her friends on the Farplane Express. His true identity is the Will of Oblivion, which took over Moneta's body just before it disappeared. Although the Will of Oblivion seems to know how to bring Fina back to life, it declares that it has no intention of telling Roca how to do so. Its overwhelming power was on full display when Roca's party tried to get this information from it by force.

locations: Symphonia, the Scholastic City - The Will of Oblivion & Moneta

name: Keeper Calice
description: A woman who calls herself a Hollow Keeper. She appeared before Roca and her friends when they visited Couleur to make Rain and Lasswell's crystals shine. Calice tries hard to come across as an intellectual sort, but she never seems to be quite all there. She is, however, an excellent fighter, and the swipes from her claws are extremely powerful.

name: Keeper Buffon
description: A man who calls himself a Hollow Keeper. He appeared in front of the party when they visited Wohlstok to make Roca's crystal shine. Seeing that Rain and the others were in good health even after having fought Calice, Buffon attacked them to test their true strength. His blades, clad in the Hollow, possess an unknown power which makes even the smallest scratch something to be feared.

name: Possessed Alphonse
description: An alchemist in a suit of armor who appears in tales of a faraway world where alchemy is practiced. He is being controlled by Pride, one of the seven Homunculus. In order to help Father fulfill his plans, Pride takes control of Alphonse's body the night before the Promised Day, and then makes his way to Edward. He must bring Edward back as one of the human sacrifices required for their schemes.

name: Scar
description: A man with a large scar on his face who appears in tales of a faraway world where alchemy is practiced. As no one knows his true identity, the military has dubbed him "Scar." He is believed to be Ishvalan, due to his dark complexion and distinctive red eyes. Having lost many of his brethren at the hands of state alchemists during the Ishvalan Civil War, he holds a deep resentment against the practice of alchemy. Ironically, he himself uses the deconstruction principle of alchemy to break down his enemies with the power of his right arm, ultimately destroying them.

name: Magissa
description: A woman who fought at the North Mountain, a location in a faraway world, against a party of crystal-blessed adventurers. She wields her whip and black magic with equal excellence. Her original aim was obtaining a wind drake horn, a treasure known to fetch huge sums. However, she changed tack after discovering an even greater bounty: Princess Lenna of Tycoon, who she weakened with a poison arrow. The towering brute Forza is in fact her husband.

description: A man who fought at the North Mountain, a location in a faraway world, against a party of crystal-blessed adventurers. The accomplice of Magissa during her attempt to kidnap Lenna, the princess of Tycoon. He puts his hulking frame to ample use, subduing foes with the sheer weight of his full-bodied tackles. Magissa, who prefers to fight with whips and black magic, is in fact his wife.

description: A monster that appears in the Torna Canal in a faraway world. Originally sealed within the canal's depths, it awoke when the wind crystal was destroyed. It attacked the Warriors of Light on their way to Walse, and following its defeat at their hands, dragged the party's sea dragon with it below the water.

name: Safer-Sephiroth
description: The completely transformed version of Sephiroth, a legendary SOLDIER and hero. He now resembles an angel with only one wing. After discovering the truth of his heritage, he devotes himself to bringing about the end of the world as his mother Jenova once attempted eons ago. Of his many and varied abilities, his Super Nova is the most devastating.

locations: (Dark Visions - The Advent of Chaos) Physical Domain of Earth and Light 1

name: Forest Armor
description: A mechanical weapon with green plating and three arms which is modeled on the image of a plant. It was developed as a countermeasure against ambush troops hiding in the forest, using a design based on ancient weaponry. Produced in vast quantities for its reconnaissance abilities, no sooner was this high-end tech developed than it had landed on the market, and even now, it is a staple of secondhand-weapon stores. These days, there are numerous engineers and munitions manufacturers who purchase these for the purpose of testing their new weapons.

Bull Shark
description: One of many different kinds of savage sharks. This creature is practically insatiable, biting even at rocks to satisfy its need to feed. Though its natural habitat lies in the warmer offshore seas, it may still catch a wave to the shore and prey on whatever it finds there. Indeed, this hunting method is a potentially fatal one for the bull shark itself if it cannot catch an outgoing wave back to sea, but this intense greed seems to be precisely what makes it so fascinating to many.

name: Adamanttata
description: A subspecies of adamantoise known for their hard shells. Its long lifespan is difficult to cut short, given its enormous resilience to attacks. Alerts are being announced all across the land saying, "Never turn your back on a fallen adamanttata. They don't stay down for long."

name: Dark Lakshmi
description: A mysterious being that descended without warning, cloaked in an ominous aura of darkness. Bearing a striking resemblance to the esper Lakshmi and brings the comforting embrace of death to weak souls who fear dark energy. Although it is every bit as powerful as an esper, it is ultimately an imposter, for where a real esper can be mindful, this creature will wreak havoc based on nothing more than an impulse. All the same, it would take no small amount of power to being down something so ferocious.

locations: Dark Visions - The Advent of Chaos (7): Physical Domain of Fire and Darkness 2
Dark Visions - The Advent of Chaos (10): Magical Domain of Fire and Darkness 2

name: Socratea
description: A wandering ivy originally developed for assassination. It approaches its victims from behind, making hardly a sound before it strikes. Its apparent creation through a merging of many different plant monsters might explain why it can only be propagated through grafting. Grafting in this case, however, involves the piercing of its vines into an unwilling human "rootstock", thereby allowing it to absorb every last bit of nourishment until it is fully grown, and its victim is nothing but a withered corpse.

name: Rosetta
description: A stone slate with mysterious etchings. Why it attacks humans is unknown, but the threat of its fierce ramming attack is unmistakable. Although there have been some attempts to decipher the etchings, none have ever been successful, as the slate always breaks into pieces after taking a certain amount of damage. Indeed, if any were to be captured in good enough condition, they would fetch a high price, but this feat has never been achieved.

name: Asbolus
description: A mechanical weapon created through technological artistry. Though it is highly intelligent and can even use human language to urge a surrender, any apparent compassion that it may express is entirely due to its programming and should not be interpreted as genuine sentiment. Its treatment of those who refuse to surrender is gruesome proof of this.

name: Enemy Soldier (Fake Actor)
description: A fake actor who has infiltrated one of Tumbleweed's performances disguised as an actor playing an enemy soldier. As these rapscallions have a serious intention to harm, failing to dodge their attacks could lead to serious injury. Their motive for interfering with Daisy's performance through repeatedly attacking her is shrouded in mystery. Thought to be acting on orders from someone seeking to interfere with Tumbleweed's—and Daisy's—operations, these fiends show the depths of the darkness that exists within the world of theater.

name: Dark Gaap
description: A strange creature that emerged from a hole conjured by a black crystal. The many tentacles that emerge from its mouth keep its prey held firmly in place. Having absorbed too much dark energy, those tentacles are now so powerful that even the most seasoned adventurer would do well not to risk capture, lest he or she meet an ultimely, squeezy end.

locations: Dark Visions - The Advent of Chaos (10): Magical Domain of Water and Light 1

name: The Rursan Arbiter
description: An entity born to deliver judgment in the faraway world of Orience as it neared its end. Originally the imperial marshal of the Militesi Empire, he was made into the Judge by the power of a certain crystal, ultimately becoming a puppet of the gods. In the deepest part of Pandæmonium, he tested those who belonged to Akademeia's Vermilion Peristylium Class Zero as to whether they bore the potential to become Agito, a messianic savior of myth.

locations: Series Boss Battle: The Rursan Arbiter

name: Destroy Witch
description: An autonomous machine enhanced from an earlier model using a powerful core. Although its predecessor was already quite threatening, this improved war machine has greatly increased output. It mercilessly decimates its designated target using its boosted magic power.

description: A researcher whose dream of becoming a hero was shattered to pieces. The invention he created in order to save others was instead used to steal a human life, filling him with despair. The dark crystal took advantage of the pain in his heart, trapping him in a prison of hatred.

name: Riotous Witch
description: An autonomous machine designed to be used as a weapon. Powered by magic, this machine only serves the purpose of annihilation, outfitted to destroy targets effectively and ruthlessly. It is said to have been created by a woman who was shunned by the scientific community for her unethical research.

name: Ice Dummy
description: A mysterious dummy infused with the power of ice capable of delivering scathing taunts, but is otherwise harmless. No one knows where it came from, but its annoying personality makes it so that everybody wants it gone.

description: A shadow born from a certain warrior's wish to become strong. Unfortunately, the wish was tainted by the magic of a Great Destroyer bent on destroying the lightning-fast warrior and her world.

Sigrien
description: A key member of a clan focused on annihilating all dragons. He holds great pride in his clan's history and is obsessed with eliminating any and all remaining dragons from the world. He is willing to do whatever it takes to accomplish his goal, even going so far as to use the power of darkness.

name: Dark Ancestral Dragon
description: A dark manifestation of the Ancestral Dragon summoned through the power of the Dark Crystal. An embodiment of the pain suffered long ago by the Ancestral Dragon at the hands of the Draconaught, it writhes in agony, furiously attacking those who come close.

name: Draconaught Warrior
description: A warrior from a clan focused on annihilating all dragons. Although there are far fewer members than there once were, they are loyal to Sigrien and aid him in his unending quest to find and eliminate any remaining dragons.

name: Sovereign Rock Castle
description: A massive castle that appears in a story of the Dragon Knight in a faraway world. This humanoid mobile fortress was built by the Dark Army in the mountains of Guildmain. Under the command of Shadow Vizier Mystvearn, it attacks the covertly gathered human leaders gathered in Papnica Kingdom. It caused many to despair after fending off even the warships and tanks of Bengarna Kingdom, which prides itself as the strongest military power in the world.

locations: Decisive Battle at Sovereign Rock Castle!

name: Restless Armour
description: A monster that appears in a story of the Dragon Knight in a faraway world. Powered by Dark Aura, these armoured warriors of the Shadow Legion are led by Shadow Vizier Mystvearn. Though not immensely powerful, it is able to produce itself ad infinium from the "Lung Chamber" in the right chest of the Sovereign Rock Castle. This material advantage caused the team of heroes quite a bit of trouble.

name: Dead Armour
description: A monster that appears in a story of the Dragon Knight in a faraway world. Powered by Dark Aura, these warriors of the ultimate armour of the Shadow Legion are led by Shadow Vizier Mystvearn. With neither weapons nor shields, they use the power bestowed by their hulking forms to fight. Seemingly made from the same metal as the Dark Armour Blade or the Dark Armour Spear, there are no chinks in the armour of this monster when it comes to defense, either.

name: Mystvearn
description: One of the six legion commanders of the Dark Army who appears in a story of the Dragon Knight in a faraway world. He leads the Shadow Legion as legion commander and is skilled at wielding Dark Aura in battle. While he despises humans who get in the way of the military rule of his majesty the Dark King Vearn, he respects the pursuit of strength, enemy or ally alike. It was out of respect for Hadlar for discarding his immortal body in the pursuit of strength that Mystvearn took command of the attack on Papnica.

name: Hym
description: A Metallic Lifeform warrior that appears in a story of the Dragon Knight in a faraway world. He was born of an orichalcum chess piece brought to life by Hadlar using Forbidden Magic. A member of the Hadlar Royal Guard, he has the abilities of a "pawn" and is a force to be reckoned with in close quarters, exhibiting unparalleled strength when he is able to close the distance with his opponent. Among his contingent, Hym is perhaps the most honorable. Having inherited much of Hadlar's personality in his transformation, he prefers to fight fair and square.

locations: DRAGON QUEST The Adventure of Dai

name: Albinass
description: A Metallic Lifeform warrior that appears in a story of the Dragon Knight in a faraway world. She was born of an orichalcum chess piece brought to life by Hadlar using Forbidden Magic. A member of the Hadlar Royal Guard, she has the abilities of a "queen" and acts as overseer and director to all the other members of the Guard. Her loyalty to Hadlar is unshakable, and she tries to act towards his interest at all times.

locations: DRAGON QUEST The Adventure of Dai

name: Sigma
description: A Metallic Lifeform warrior that appears in a story of the Dragon Knight in a faraway world. He was born of an orichalcum chess piece brought to life by Hadlar using Forbidden Magic. A member of the Hadlar Royal Guard, he has the abilities of a "knight" and has incredible mobility on the battlefield, specializing in such maneuvers as high-speed movement and leaping attacks. With his legendary "Mirror of Shahal," an artifact he uses as both armament and armor, it is said that he can repel all types of magic back upon his opponent.

locations: DRAGON QUEST The Adventure of Dai

name: Block
description: A Metallic Lifeform warrior that appears in a story of the Dragon Knight in a faraway world. He was born of an orichalcum chess piece brought to life by Hadlar using Forbidden Magic. A member of the Hadlar Royal Guard, he has the abilities of a "rook" and possesses awe-inspiring strength and a strong, stout body. He isn't capable of much speech, but like the other members of his contingent, he is willing to put his life on the line for Hadlar.

locations: DRAGON QUEST The Adventure of Dai

name: Fenbren
description: A Metallic Lifeform warrior that appears in a story of the Dragon Knight in a faraway world. He was born of an orichalcum chess piece brought to life by Hadlar using Forbidden Magic. A member of the Hadlar Royal Guard, he has the abilities of a "bishop" and specializes in ambushes and surprise attacks. Over eighty percent of his body is made up of sharp blades that slice all ordinary weapons to pieces should an enemy manage to land an attack.

locations: DRAGON QUEST The Adventure of Dai

name: Lon Beruk
description: A man that appears in a story of the Dragon Knight in a faraway world. A master craftsman from the Underworld, he forged countless legendary weapons, including the "Sword of Dai," a weapon to rival the most powerful sword on earth, the "Demon Dragon Blade." Once counted among the greatest swordsmen in the Underworld, his skill with a blade is unmatched. He has gone to great lengths for the heroic group, including simultaneously sparring with Dai and Hyunckel as training and forging new weapons for Popp and the other party members.

name: Furchtrose Omega
description: A ferocious plant monster which seems to contain a glowing core of some kind. The tentacle-like tendrils are lined with sharp spines, culminating in tips which resemble the jaws of a beast ready to gnash at its prey. The strengths of specimens parasitized by Omega cores vary based on the host and must be uniquely identified, making them formidable foes indeed.

locations: Search and Destroy: Flora Omega Spawn

name: Grüner Drache Omega
description: A dragon corrupted by an Omega core. Parts of its body appear to have become mechanized following heavy contamination of the organic tissue. Most Omega spawn are only corrupted to a certain extent, as their flesh cannot handle further strain. For mighty creatures such as dragons, however, symptoms can continue to worsen nearly without end. Some rumors hold that this dragon was artificially inflicted, and that its behavior is a result of resentment for this vile act against nature.

name: Proto-Omega
description: A massive machine modeled after Omega. Though it is inferior to its original, it nevertheless boasts fearsome destructive power as a strategic weapon. Only one with the qualities of an Omeganaut may activate and control it. For this reason, pilots of Proto-Omega are thought to be capable of fusing even with Omega itself.

locations: VS Proto-Omega and Golden Bomb Omega (EX-1)

name: Alpha Weltall

locations: The Scarlet Demon and the Dark-Winged Destroyer+

name: Hammer
description: A Gear from a distant world. It was constructed by merging a demi-human's body with a mechanical base. Crafted with the physical form of Hammer the Supplier, it is more akin to a cyborg than an actual Gear. Though he was once allied with Fei and company, he was convinced to turn traitor by Krelian, who preyed on his deep-seated envy toward those with power. Machines of this model are capable of transforming desires into Ether—thus, the more powerful the emotion, the more powerful the Gear.

name: Deus
description: A living weapon which once slumbered in a distant world. The core of the Deus interplanetary invasion system, it evolved from a nascent stage to its current first form over a period of ten thousand years. Though it was defeated by Fei and company in Mahanon, a paradise in the sky, it had already transferred the piece of itself which would become the core of its second form. Deus would then begin to terraform with the planet to grant it the power of interstellar travel.

name: Amphysvena
description: An Omnigear from a distant world, piloted by Commander Ramsus of the imperial foreign affairs ministry Gebler. It appeared before Fei and company as they made for the Merkava in a bid to rescue Elly. Not even the voice of his adoring subordinate can reach Ramsus, who wholeheartedly believes that Fei's existance threatens the very meaning of his own. The victim of Miang and Krelian's masterful emotional manipulation, Ramsus's mind has been pushed to its breaking point.

name: Opiomorph
description: An Omnigear from a distant world, piloted by Miang, an aide to Commander Ramsus of the imperial foreign affairs ministry Gebler. It appeared before Fei and company as they made for the Merkava in a bid to rescue Elly. An exceptionally powerful Gear further strengthened by its pilot, its most astonishing feature is its ability for self-repair. Granted the power of nanomachines by Krelian, it will continue to revive itself unless deconstructed at the atomic level.

name: Stroper
Riesigrex Omega
description: An ancient dragon which seems to contain a glowing core of some kind. A grisly horn sprouts from its back. Its already-ferocious temperament has been intensified even further, and the creature will now indiscriminately set upon anything that moves. The strengths of specimens parasitized by Omega cores vary based on the host and must be uniquely identified, making them formidable foes indeed.

name: True Weltall
description: An Omnigear from a distant world, born from the alignment of a young man's Gear with the Anima Relic Naphtali. Its innate powers were brought forth following contact with the Zohar Modifier, granting it bat-like wings which sprout from its back. Grahf, aiming to eradicate all life together with Deus, piloted this Gear against Fei's Xenogears, though he was ultimately defeated. Entrusting his will to the young man, Grahf chose to merge with the Zohar in order to halt it, however temporarily.

name: Demon Wall
description: A fearsome trap which was set in the Sealed Cave, a location in a faraway world. The white wall, which features a demon's grisly form on its surface, was constructed to crush those who would steal the Dark Crystal. Having some method of handling its brutally powerful "crash down" ability, as well as its "stone gaze," is paramount indeed.

name: Vampire Bat
description: A bat which appears in the Sealed Cave, a location in a faraway world. It has a purple body and sharp fangs. The Sealed Cave, which is found deep within the Underworld of its original home, is said to have been the resting place of one of the Dark Crystals.

name: Lesser Marilith
description: A ghastly monster which appears in the Sealed Cave, a location in a faraway world. The lower half of its body seems ready to fade away, almost as though the creature were some malign spirit. It is said to immediately assail humans that enter its sight, furiously shaking its long hair.

name: Nagaraja
description: A malformed monster which appears in the Sealed Cave, a location in a faraway world. Though it possesses a human head, it has the body of a snake from the head down. In the nagaraja's world of origin, there appear to have been wicked summoners who would summon it, setting it upon other humans.

name: Vampiress
description: A female vampire which appears in the Sealed Cave, a location in a faraway world. She is known to hang from the cavern's ceiling, waiting for unsuspecting prey. In their world of origin, such vampiresses often appeared with vampire bats in tow.

name: Trap Door
description: A door-shaped monster which appears in the Sealed Cave, a location in a faraway world. It attacks those who attempt to open it and proceed onward. At first glance, it is nearly identical to a regular door—a trait for which it is much maligned. It is known to target its prey before dragging them into an alternate plane with its "ninth dimension" ability.

name: Ultros
Askah
description: The lieutenant commander of Caledfwlch's Unit 1. As the second-strongest warrior in the unit, he boasts power far exceeding the likes of Rhus and Neilikka. He is deeply interested in Rain's blood awakening, which is somehow different from the mark of transcendence used within Caledfwlch. Confronted by Rain, who is enraged and despondent over Vanharma's trap, Askah accepts the young warrior's challenge in order to measure the extent of his strength.

name: Tulien
description: A man who calls himself a true hero. After rescuing Lehftia and Haveh from Omega spawn, he opts to travel alongside them. Never a man to hesitate when it comes to defending the weak, he seems to possess a firm conviction regarding the true meaning of heroism, vowing to live and die as a hero. It is this same conviction which guides him to challenge Taivas.

locations: Path through the Mountains - A True Hero's Power
Crossroads of Determination - I Swear I'll Stop You!!

name: Kylma
description: An elite researcher said to be at the very top of the Elmont Royal Laboratory. Recognized as a mad scientist by herself and others, she insists that it is precisely that madness which has elevated her to the forefront of humanity. Both a researcher and a preeminent fighter, she now pursues Taivas and company, making use of her trained physique and impressive marksmanship.

locations: Crossroads of Determination - The Mad Scientist
Zeil Research Facility - Born of Human Hands
Zeil Research Facility - VS Belmodar Omega and Kylma (EX-1)
